architectural_modifications: Expand missing-information states to include OBSERVED_ABSENT, NOT_AUTHORIZED_TO_REQUEST, REQUEST_PROHIBITED, REQUEST_DEFERRED, SOURCE_SILENT, PARTIALLY_AVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED, COST_PROHIBITED, PRIVACY_RESTRICTED, RETENTION_EXPIRED, and UNKNOWN_CAUSE.
Require cause, authority, requesting office, affected decision path, and learning consequence for each missing-information declaration.
Require closure disposition for every missing-information state before journey certification.
audit_objective: Determine whether missing-information preservation is complete and learning-ready.
baseline_rules: Missing information is a first-class historical fact.
Historian records absence cause without inferring unavailable content.
Enterprise Learning receives missing-information classifications, not reconstructed guesses.
constitutional_weaknesses: Existing missing states omit materially distinct enterprise learning signals.
Absent data could be collapsed into generic unavailable status.
Unknown and deliberately unobserved states were not separated.
residual_risks: Some external-source restrictions may require legal or policy authorities not yet modeled.
title: Missing Information Hardening
